requirements.title: Control cannot transfer into a block from outside except for a return from an invoked procedure
requirements.source: 11.1.2.1 p1 first sentence; J3/24-007 PDF p203.
requirements.definition: Transfer of control from outside a block to a statement in the block is prohibited. The exception is the return from a procedure that was invoked within the block. Branching constructs, labels, and procedure return semantics are separate dependencies.

requirements.title: Transfers within a block and transfers from a block to outside are permitted forms
requirements.source: 11.1.2.1 p1 final sentence; J3/24-007 PDF p203.
requirements.definition: The language permits transfers within a block and transfers from the interior of a block to outside the block, subject to the branch, RETURN, EXIT, CYCLE, and construct-specific rules that own those transfers. This is a permission, not a requirement that any transfer occur.
requirements.oracle:
Do not require a processor to choose or exercise a transfer. Future fixtures may only show that a conforming source shape is admitted and then rely on the owning branch rule for execution.

requirements.title: Procedure references may appear inside a block
requirements.definition: Subroutine and function references are permitted to appear in a block. The call/reference syntax, argument association, result values, and side effects are owned by Clause 15 and expression/assignment dependencies.
requirements.oracle:
